entry.title: Presenting UX Research And Design To Stakeholders: The Power Of Persuasion
entry.summary: There’s more to achieving good UX than research and design. We need to effectively communicate our ideas to gain buy-in from key stakeholders. Victor covers how UX practitioners can harness the power of persuasion and other tactics from the field of communication when presenting research findings and design concepts to key stakeholders.
